analysis.research_question_and_background: The emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b as the predominant lineage in poultry has raised concerns about the protective efficacy of existing commercial vaccines, particularly in domestic ducks which are key to virus maintenance and transmission.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated four inactivated H5 vaccines against a recently isolated local HPAI H5N1 strain (Newvalley-3-H5N1-2024, clade 2.3.4.4b) in Pekin ducks in Egypt, using 150 seronegative ducks divided into vaccinated and control groups.
analysis.methods: Ducks were vaccinated at 10 days of age and challenged at 31 days with 10^6.5 EID50/0.5 mL via the oculo-nasal route, with vaccine efficacy assessed through clinical signs, survival, HI antibody titers, viral shedding by real-time RT-PCR, and histopathological examination of trachea, lung, pancreas, and brain tissues.
analysis.main_results: Vaccination with ValleyVac Avian Flu H5 plus and MEFLUVACTM H5 PLUS 8 resulted in 100% survival at 10 days post-vaccination, while the positive control group had a 66.7% mortality rate, and mortality in other vaccinated groups ranged from 6.7% to 13.4%.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as demonstrating that ValleyVac Avian Flu H5 plus and MEFLUVACTM H5 PLUS 8 provide superior protection against the local HPAI H5N1 strain compared to other vaccines tested, highlighting their potential as effective interventions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that targeted inactivated vaccines can reduce mortality and viral shedding in domestic ducks, informing vaccination strategies to control HPAI H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b in poultry.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a single local HPAI H5N1 strain and a short follow-up period, which may not capture long-term immunity or broader strain variability, warranting cautious interpretation of the evidence strength as moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of four inactivated H5 vaccines against a recently isolated highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b strain in Pekin ducks in Egypt. Using 150 seronegative ducks divided into vaccinated and control groups, the authors evaluated survival, antibody titers, viral shedding, and histopathological outcomes after challenge with the local HPAI H5N1 strain. Vaccination with ValleyVac Avian Flu H5 plus and MEFLUVACTM H5 PLUS 8 achieved 100% survival compared to 66.7% mortality in the positive control group, with other vaccines showing intermediate protection. papers.title: Newton Divided Difference Optimization for Fingerprint-Based Neural Virtual Screening against Avian Influenza A/H9N2
papers.abstract: Avian influenza A/H9N2 poses persistent zoonotic and veterinary threats, yet efficient computational tools for antiviral compound prioritization remain underdeveloped, particularly with respect to optimizer behavior in high-dimensional neural screening. This study proposes Newton Divided Difference (NDD) optimization, a lightweight positive diagonal curvature-aware training strategy, as a novel optimizer for fingerprint-based neural virtual screening against avian influenza A/H9N2, with the objective of evaluating its performance across aligned molecular fingerprint representations and chemically structured validation protocols. An aligned benchmark of 1,459 molecules consisting of 615 candidate active compounds and 844 decoys was represented by EState (79 features), PubChem (881 features), and Klekota–Roth (4,860 features) fingerprints, sharing identical molecule identities, labels, and split assignments. A fixed multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifier was trained with NDD and seven baseline optimizers under stratified, scaffold-key, and similarity-cluster split protocols across five repeated seeds. NDD achieved the highest descriptive ROC-AUC (Receiver Operating Characteriztic – Area Under the Curve) and PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under the Curve) on Klekota–Roth fingerprints under scaffold-key and similarity-cluster protocols, and remained competitive under the stratified split with ROC-AUC of 0.9872. Architecture-sensitivity tests confirmed stable NDD performance across multiple network configurations, with ROC-AUC values ranging from 0.9876 to 0.9890. Compared with Hessian-free optimization, NDD reduced per-run runtime from approximately 50–54 seconds to approximately 8 seconds on Klekota–Roth under the same CPU-only configuration while achieving comparable ranking performance. The novelty of this work lies in the first systematic assessment of NDD for H9N2 neural virtual screening, demonstrating that positive diagonal curvature-aware scaling provides a practical, stable, and computationally efficient optimization alternative in sparse high-dimensional ligand-based screening settings, although external validation and prospective experimental confirmation remain necessary before practical antiviral prioritization.

papers.title_zh: 针对 禽流感 A/H9N2 基于指纹的神经虚拟筛选的牛顿差分优化
papers.source_body_en: Avian influenza A/H9N2 poses persistent zoonotic and veterinary threats, yet efficient computational tools for antiviral compound prioritization remain underdeveloped, particularly with respect to optimizer behavior in high-dimensional neural screening. This study proposes Newton Divided Difference (NDD) optimization, a lightweight positive diagonal curvature-aware training strategy, as a novel optimizer for fingerprint-based neural virtual screening against avian influenza A/H9N2, with the objective of evaluating its performance across aligned molecular fingerprint representations and chemically structured validation protocols. An aligned benchmark of 1,459 molecules consisting of 615 candidate active compounds and 844 decoys was represented by EState (79 features), PubChem (881 features), and Klekota–Roth (4,860 features) fingerprints, sharing identical molecule identities, labels, and split assignments. A fixed multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifier was trained with NDD and seven baseline optimizers under stratified, scaffold-key, and similarity-cluster split protocols across five repeated seeds. NDD achieved the highest descriptive ROC-AUC (Receiver Operating Characteriztic – Area Under the Curve) and PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under the Curve) on Klekota–Roth fingerprints under scaffold-key and similarity-cluster protocols, and remained competitive under the stratified split with ROC-AUC of 0.9872. Architecture-sensitivity tests confirmed stable NDD performance across multiple network configurations, with ROC-AUC values ranging from 0.9876 to 0.9890. Compared with Hessian-free optimization, NDD reduced per-run runtime from approximately 50–54 seconds to approximately 8 seconds on Klekota–Roth under the same CPU-only configuration while achieving comparable ranking performance. The novelty of this work lies in the first systematic assessment of NDD for H9N2 neural virtual screening, demonstrating that positive diagonal curvature-aware scaling provides a practical, stable, and computationally efficient optimization alternative in sparse high-dimensional ligand-based screening settings, although external validation and prospective experimental confirmation remain necessary before practical antiviral prioritization.
papers.abstract_zh: 禽流感 A/H9N2 造成持续的人畜共患病和兽医威胁,但用于 抗病毒药物 化合物优先级排序的有效计算工具仍然不发达,特别是在高维神经筛选中的​​优化器行为方面。本研究提出了牛顿除差(NDD)优化,这是一种轻量级正对角曲率感知训练策略,作为针对 禽流感 A/H9N2 的基于指纹的神经虚拟筛选的新型优化器,目的是评估其在对齐的分子指纹表示和化学结构验证协议中的性能。由 615 种候选活性化合物和 844 种诱饵组成的 1,459 个分子的对齐基准由 EState(79 个特征)、PubChem(881 个特征)和 Klekota–Roth(4,860 个特征)指纹代表,共享相同的分子身份、标签和分割分配。固定多层感知器 (MLP) 分类器使用 NDD 和七个基线优化器在分层、支架键和相似性聚类分割协议下跨五个重复种子进行训练。NDD 在支架密钥和相似性聚类协议下的 Klekota–Roth 指纹上实现了最高的描述性 ROC-AUC(接收者操作特征 - 曲线下面积)和 PR-AUC(曲线下精确召回面积),并且在分层分割下保持竞争力,ROC-AUC 为 0.9872。架构敏感性测试证实了跨多种网络配置的稳定 NDD 性能,ROC-AUC 值范围为 0.9876 至 0.9890。与无 Hessian 优化相比,在相同的仅 CPU 配置下,NDD 将 Klekota-Roth 上的每次运行时间从大约 50-54 秒减少到大约 8 秒,同时实现了相当的排名性能。这项工作的新颖性在于首次系统评估 H9N2 神经虚拟筛选的 NDD,证明正对角线曲率感知缩放在稀疏高维配体筛选设置中提供了实用、稳定且计算高效的优化替代方案,尽管在实际 抗病毒药物 优先级排序之前仍然需要外部验证和前瞻性实验确认。

papers.title: Complete genome sequence of BLRI-developed inactivated avian influenza A/H9N2 vaccine strain in Bangladesh
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The H9N2 Avian influenza virus is widely distributed and is responsible for significant economic losses in the global poultry industry. An A/H9N2 inactivated vaccine has been developed from the local circulating strain A/chicken/Bangladesh/NRL-H9-1767/2022(H9N2). The local isolate belongs to the G5.7 lineage. Here, we report the complete genome sequence of the Bangladesh Livestock Research Institute-developed A/H9N2 vaccine strain.

papers.title: Investigating host intracellular proteins with antiviral activity against influenza and herpesviruses
papers.abstract: Human pathogenic viruses present an ongoing global public health problem, as reflected by continuing endemic infections, seasonal epidemics, and pandemics caused by newly emerging viruses. While many intracellular host proteins fulfil defined roles in normal cellular physiology and function, a subset exert intrinsic antiviral activity and are termed host restriction factors. Host restriction factors represent an important component of innate antiviral immunity and can inhibit infection and/or replication of different DNA and/or RNA viruses at distinct stages in their viral replication cycle. This thesis has focussed on studying how two host restriction factors, namely SAM domain and HD domain-containing protein 1 (SAMHD1) and Membrane-associated RING-CH-Type Finger 8 protein (MARCHF8), restrict different RNA and DNA viruses. Studies described in Chapter 3 investigated the antiviral activity of SAMHD1 against respiratory RNA viruses in human macrophage-like and epithelial cells. Using human herpes simplex type 1 virus (HSV-1) as a control to validate the functionality of our approaches, we demonstrated that neither endogenous nor overexpressed SAMHD restricted seasonal influenza A virus (IAV), human metapneumovirus (HMPV) and human parainfluenza virus type 3 (hPIV3) replication in either cell type. However, overexpression of SAMHD1 inhibited highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAI) A(H5N1) in human macrophage-like cells. HSV-1 infects a wide range of cell types, including epithelial cells, keratinocytes, astrocytes, neurons and immune cells, yet most studies published to date have investigated the role of SAMHD1 in restricting HSV-1 replication in monocytes and macrophages. elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该论文使用与病毒 发病机制 相关的人和牛细胞模型研究了两个 宿主 限制因子 SAMHD1 和 MARCHF8。研究重点是巨噬细胞样细胞、上皮细胞、神经元细胞、星形细胞和角质细胞细胞类型中的呼吸道 RNA 病毒、疱疹病毒和 1 型牛疱疹病毒 (BHV-1)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用诱导过表达系统在相关细胞系中表达人和牛 SAMHD1,从而能够评估 抗病毒药物 针对甲型流感病毒 (IAV)、人偏肺病毒 (HMPV)、人副流感病毒 3 型 (hPIV3)、单纯疱疹病毒 1 型 (HSV-1) 和 BHV-1 的活性。功能测定检查了病毒基因组复制、晚期基因表达和限制机制。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Human pathogenic viruses remain a persistent global public health threat due to endemic infections, seasonal epidemics, and emerging pandemics. Host restriction factors constitute a critical component of innate antiviral immunity that can inhibit diverse DNA and RNA viruses at multiple stages of their replication cycles.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The thesis investigated two host restriction factors, SAMHD1 and MARCHF8, using human and bovine cell models relevant to viral pathogenesis. Studies focused on respiratory RNA viruses, herpesviruses, and bovine herpesvirus type 1 (BHV-1) in macrophage-like, epithelial, neuronal, astrocytic, and keratinocyte cell types.
analysis_en.methods: Inducible overexpression systems were used to express human and bovine SAMHD1 in relevant cell lines, enabling assessment of antiviral activity against influenza A virus (IAV), human metapneumovirus (HMPV), human parainfluenza virus type 3 (hPIV3), herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1), and BHV-1. Functional assays examined viral genomic replication, late gene expression, and restriction mechanisms.
analysis_en.main_results: Endogenous SAMHD1 did not restrict seasonal IAV, HMPV, or hPIV3 replication in macrophage-like or epithelial cells, but overexpression inhibited highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) in macrophage-like cells. Endogenous SAMHD1 restricted HSV-1 replication only in differentiated THP-1 macrophages, while overexpression restricted HSV-1 in neuronal but not keratinocyte or astrocytic cell lines. Both human and bovine SAMHD1 restricted BHV-1 replication, with dNTPase activity required for restriction. MARCHF8 restricted HSV-1 replication by inhibiting genomic replication and late gene expression, independent of SAMHD1, CD81, and cGAS-STING pathways.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: These findings demonstrate that SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 act as broad-spectrum host restriction factors across distinct viral classes via mechanisms distinct from those previously described. The study reports the first evidence of MARCHF8-mediated restriction of a DNA virus and identifies cell-type-dependent antiviral activity of SAMHD1.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the potential of host-directed antiviral strategies targeting SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 to combat diverse viral infections. They also suggest that bovine SAMHD1 could inform control measures for BHV-1, a pathogen with significant economic impact in cattle.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to in vitro cell models and does not address in vivo efficacy or clinical relevance. The strength of evidence is moderate due to reliance on overexpression systems and absence of animal model validation.

papers.title_zh: 研究具有 抗病毒药物 抗流感和疱疹病毒活性的 宿主 细胞内蛋白
papers.source_body_en: Human pathogenic viruses present an ongoing global public health problem, as reflected by continuing endemic infections, seasonal epidemics, and pandemics caused by newly emerging viruses. While many intracellular host proteins fulfil defined roles in normal cellular physiology and function, a subset exert intrinsic antiviral activity and are termed host restriction factors. Host restriction factors represent an important component of innate antiviral immunity and can inhibit infection and/or replication of different DNA and/or RNA viruses at distinct stages in their viral replication cycle. This thesis has focussed on studying how two host restriction factors, namely SAM domain and HD domain-containing protein 1 (SAMHD1) and Membrane-associated RING-CH-Type Finger 8 protein (MARCHF8), restrict different RNA and DNA viruses. Studies described in Chapter 3 investigated the antiviral activity of SAMHD1 against respiratory RNA viruses in human macrophage-like and epithelial cells. Using human herpes simplex type 1 virus (HSV-1) as a control to validate the functionality of our approaches, we demonstrated that neither endogenous nor overexpressed SAMHD restricted seasonal influenza A virus (IAV), human metapneumovirus (HMPV) and human parainfluenza virus type 3 (hPIV3) replication in either cell type. However, overexpression of SAMHD1 inhibited highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAI) A(H5N1) in human macrophage-like cells. HSV-1 infects a wide range of cell types, including epithelial cells, keratinocytes, astrocytes, neurons and immune cells, yet most studies published to date have investigated the role of SAMHD1 in restricting HSV-1 replication in monocytes and macrophages. In Chapter 4, we focussed on assessment of SAMHD1 expression and its role in restricting HSV-1 replication in different cell types relevant to HSV-1 pathogenesis, including keratinocytes, neurons and astrocytes. We report that endogenous SAMHD1 did not restrict HSV-1 replication in any of the neuron, astrocyte or keratinocyte cell models tested, whereas restriction was observed in differentiated THP-1 macrophages. In contrast, inducible overexpression of SAMHD1 in neuronal, but not in keratinocyte cell lines, resulted in HSV-1 restriction, with variable results observed following overexpression in an astrocytic cell line. We also used human small molecule neural precursor cells (smNPCs), derived from human pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) and differentiated into neurons or astrocytes, to confirm that endogenous SAMHD1 did not restrict HSV-1 replication in either cell type. Together, these results indicate that the capacity of both endogenous and overexpressed SAMHD1 to restrict HSV-1 replication is cell-type dependent. We extended our studies of human SAMHD1 and herpesviruses to investigate the ability of bovine SAMHD1 to restrict replication of human and bovine herpesviruses (Chapter 5). We used an inducible overexpression system to express bovine SAMHD1 and, for comparison, human SAMHD1 in bovine epithelial- and macrophage-like cells, enabling assessment of their ability to restrict bovine herpesvirus type 1 (BHV-1) replication. We demonstrate that inducible expression of either bovine or human SAMHD1 restricted the replication of BHV-1, as well as HSV-1. Restriction of BHV-1 by bovine SAMHD1 correlated with the inhibition of viral genomic replication and late viral gene expression. Furthermore, by introducing mutations known to impact the nuclear localisation, dNTPase activity or antiviral activity against lentiviruses, we show that only dNTPase activity was required for restriction of BHV-1 by bovine SAMHD1. In Chapter 6, we report the ability of MARCHF8 to restrict HSV-1 replication in macrophage- or epithelial-like cells. While it is widely established that MARCHF8 can restrict replication of several RNA viruses, this represents the first report of its ability to act against a DNA virus. For many RNA viruses, MARCHF8-mediated restriction has been associated with downregulation of viral envelope glycoproteins from the cell surface, thereby limiting their subsequent incorporation into nascent virions. However, while MARCHF8 expression did not affect virus entry, translocation of viral genome to the nucleus and immediate early (IE) gene expression, it did inhibit HSV-1 genomic replication, and therefore subsequent late viral gene expression and release of infectious virions. MARCHF8-mediated restriction of HSV-1 occurred independent of other cellular factors known to impact genomic replication of HSV-1, namely SAMHD1 and CD81, and could also proceed efficiently in cells expressing a functional cGAS-STING pathway. To our knowledge, these studies are the first to demonstrate MARCHF8-mediated restriction of a human DNA virus. Moreover, inhibition of HSV-1 genomic replication represents a novel mechanism of MARCHF8-mediated virus restriction that is distinct to its reported antiviral activity against RNA viruses. Overall, our studies indicate that SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 represent broad-spectrum host restriction factors with the ability to act across different classes of viruses with distinct viral genomes, likely via mechanisms distinct to those previously described. Furthermore, we demonstrate the potential of bovine SAMHD1 to restrict replication of BHV-1, a bovine herpesvirus associated with significant economic impact in the cattle industry. Targeting host restriction factors such as SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 represents a promising approach for the development of novel host-directed antiviral therapies.

papers.title: Genome-wide association study reveals putative genetic determinants of longitudinal immune responses to avian influenza and Newcastle disease in chickens
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Avian Influenza virus (AIV) and Newcastle disease virus (NDV) are highly contagious immunosuppressive pathogens that cause high mortality rates and economic losses in the global poultry industry. Although vaccination to enhance the host antibody response remains the main control strategy, the genetic basis of this variation is poorly understood. In this study, we used a genome-wide association study (GWAS) to investigate the genetic architecture of the longitudinal antibody responses to AIV (subtypes H5, H7, and H9) and NDV in chickens. Results To identify the genomic regions and candidate genes associated with the longitudinal antibody response to AIV and NDV after immunization, we conducted a GWAS using 1,359,927 SNP markers in an advanced intercross line (AIL) of the F19 resource population. We found moderate heritability for both the traits. Based on these associations, we identified the genomic regions and candidate genes for both traits. Association analysis revealed two significant SNPs located on chromosome 3, rs316474025 near NFKBIE and SLC35B2 [rs316474025], and rs312870707 near ATG5 gene, that are associated with viral antibody titers against AIV subtypes H5 and H7, respectively. Additionally, one variant on chromosome 27, rs318005864 near DDK12 and RPL19 genes, was strongly linked to the antibody response associated with NDV at mid-phase (40 days post-immunization). Furthermore, another variant, rs737164663, near FRMD5 and GLCE genes, was strongly linked to the antibody titer associated with both AIV subtype H9 and NDV in the late phase (60 days post-immunization). Genes located in these regions may be responsible for the immune response in chickens. Before implementation in breeding programs, the efficacy and long-term persistence of selecting these antibody response traits should be validated in larger independent cohorts. Conclusions We confirmed the presence of genetic variability and identified SNPs significantly associated with antibody titer traits in F19 chickens. These findings highlight genomic regions contributing to variation in antibody responses and provide valuable information for improving antibody-related traits through selective breeding programs.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the poorly understood genetic basis for variation in antibody responses to avian influenza virus (AIV) and Newcastle disease virus (NDV) in chickens despite vaccination being the main control strategy for these immunosuppressive pathogens.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A genome-wide association study (GWAS) was conducted using an advanced intercross line (AIL) of the F19 resource population to investigate longitudinal antibody responses to AIV subtypes H5, H7, and H9 and NDV in chickens.
analysis.methods: The GWAS analyzed 1,359,927 SNP markers to identify genomic regions and candidate genes associated with longitudinal antibody responses to AIV and NDV after immunization.
analysis.main_results: Moderate heritability was observed for antibody response traits. Two significant SNPs on chromosome 3 (rs316474025 near NFKBIE and SLC35B2 for AIV H5, and rs312870707 near ATG5 for AIV H7) and one variant on chromosome 27 (rs318005864 near DDK12 and RPL19) linked to NDV antibody response at 40 days post-immunization were identified.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as confirmation of genetic variability in antibody responses and highlighted the identified SNPs as novel genomic regions contributing to variation in antibody titers in chickens.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide genomic targets for selective breeding programs to improve antibody-related traits in poultry, potentially enhancing vaccine-induced immunity against AIV and NDV.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to an abstract-only report, lacks detailed methods and results, and the authors note that efficacy and long-term persistence of selecting these traits require validation in larger independent cohorts before implementation.

analysis.summary_en: This abstract-only study used a genome-wide association study (GWAS) in an advanced intercross line (AIL) of F19 chickens to investigate genetic determinants of longitudinal antibody responses to avian influenza virus (AIV) subtypes H5, H7, and H9 and Newcastle disease virus (NDV). Moderate heritability was observed for antibody response traits, and two significant SNPs on chromosome 3 (rs316474025 near NFKBIE and SLC35B2 for AIV H5, and rs312870707 near ATG5 for AIV H7) and one variant on chromosome 27 (rs318005864 near DDK12 and RPL19) linked to NDV antibody response at 40 days post-immunization were identified. The authors concluded that these genomic regions contribute to variation in antibody responses and provide targets for selective breeding programs to improve vaccine-induced immunity in poultry. However, the evidence is limited to an abstract-only report and requires validation in larger independent cohorts before practical implementation.

papers.title_zh: 基因组 全关联研究揭示了纵向 基因组 至 禽流感 和鸡新城疫的假定遗传决定因素
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Avian Influenza virus (AIV) and Newcastle disease virus (NDV) are highly contagious immunosuppressive pathogens that cause high mortality rates and economic losses in the global poultry industry. Although vaccination to enhance the host antibody response remains the main control strategy, the genetic basis of this variation is poorly understood. In this study, we used a genome-wide association study (GWAS) to investigate the genetic architecture of the longitudinal antibody responses to AIV (subtypes H5, H7, and H9) and NDV in chickens. Results To identify the genomic regions and candidate genes associated with the longitudinal antibody response to AIV and NDV after immunization, we conducted a GWAS using 1,359,927 SNP markers in an advanced intercross line (AIL) of the F19 resource population. We found moderate heritability for both the traits. Based on these associations, we identified the genomic regions and candidate genes for both traits. Association analysis revealed two significant SNPs located on chromosome 3, rs316474025 near NFKBIE and SLC35B2 [rs316474025], and rs312870707 near ATG5 gene, that are associated with viral antibody titers against AIV subtypes H5 and H7, respectively. Additionally, one variant on chromosome 27, rs318005864 near DDK12 and RPL19 genes, was strongly linked to the antibody response associated with NDV at mid-phase (40 days post-immunization). Furthermore, another variant, rs737164663, near FRMD5 and GLCE genes, was strongly linked to the antibody titer associated with both AIV subtype H9 and NDV in the late phase (60 days post-immunization). Genes located in these regions may be responsible for the immune response in chickens. Before implementation in breeding programs, the efficacy and long-term persistence of selecting these antibody response traits should be validated in larger independent cohorts. Conclusions We confirmed the presence of genetic variability and identified SNPs significantly associated with antibody titer traits in F19 chickens. These findings highlight genomic regions contributing to variation in antibody responses and provide valuable information for improving antibody-related traits through selective breeding programs.

papers.title: Rapid Detection of N9 Subtype Avian Influenza Viruses Using an NA-Targeting Lateral Flow Immunoassay
papers.abstract: The emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses (AIVs) poses significant threats to global public health and the poultry economy. Rapid detection methods targeting the hemagglutinin (HA) protein have become increasingly unreliable due to ongoing antigenic drift and genetic mutations. In this study, we screened two monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) against the highly conserved neuraminidase (NA) protein, which were characterized by high affinity and specificity for the N9 subtype. Using the paired mAbs 12A2 and 12F12, an NA-targeting lateral flow immunoassay (NA-LFIA) was developed for the rapid detection of N9 subtype AIVs. The NA-LFIA demonstrated exceptional specificity, exhibiting no cross-reactivity with the N1, N2, or N6 subtypes. The limits of detection (LODs) were established at 103.3 TCID50/0.1 mL for the virus and 98 ng/mL for the recombinant NA protein. The test strips exhibited excellent reproductivity for detecting the NA antigen, with intra-assay and inter-assay variations of 5.32% and 6.05%, respectively. Stability testing confirmed a six-month shelf life without any loss of sensitivity. These finds indicate that the NA-LFIA is a robust, rapid point-of-care testing (POCT) tool for the early detection of N9 subtype AIV infection.

papers.title_zh: 使用 NA 靶向侧流免疫分析快速检测 N9 亚型 禽流感 病毒
papers.source_body_en: The emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses (AIVs) poses significant threats to global public health and the poultry economy. Rapid detection methods targeting the hemagglutinin (HA) protein have become increasingly unreliable due to ongoing antigenic drift and genetic mutations. In this study, we screened two monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) against the highly conserved neuraminidase (NA) protein, which were characterized by high affinity and specificity for the N9 subtype. Using the paired mAbs 12A2 and 12F12, an NA-targeting lateral flow immunoassay (NA-LFIA) was developed for the rapid detection of N9 subtype AIVs. The NA-LFIA demonstrated exceptional specificity, exhibiting no cross-reactivity with the N1, N2, or N6 subtypes. The limits of detection (LODs) were established at 103.3 TCID50/0.1 mL for the virus and 98 ng/mL for the recombinant NA protein. The test strips exhibited excellent reproductivity for detecting the NA antigen, with intra-assay and inter-assay variations of 5.32% and 6.05%, respectively. Stability testing confirmed a six-month shelf life without any loss of sensitivity. These finds indicate that the NA-LFIA is a robust, rapid point-of-care testing (POCT) tool for the early detection of N9 subtype AIV infection.

papers.title: Assessment of Humoral Immunogenicity of ChAdOx1 H5 HA Influenza Vaccine for Dairy Cattle
papers.abstract: Background/objectives: The emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) virus infections in dairy cattle in the United States revealed a novel mammalian host and a potential transmission pathway involving raw milk and dairy production systems. Sustained circulation of H5N1 in dairy herds is of concern because ongoing viral adaptation in mammals may increase the risk of efficient mammalian transmission and subsequent zoonotic spread. In response to this emerging threat, we developed a chimpanzee adenovirus (ChAd)-vectored vaccine expressing the haemagglutinin 5 antigen (H5HA) from the dairy cattle isolate A/dairy cattle/Texas. Methods: Lactating dairy cows were vaccinated by either intramuscular (N = 3) or intranasal administration (N = 3). H5HA clade 2.3.4.4b antibodies in cow’s milk and sera were evaluated by ELISA. Hemagglutination and neutralisation capacity were also evaluated. Results: IgG and IgA H5HA-specific antibodies were detected in serum and milk from parenterally vaccinated animals, demonstrating the induction of a systemic immune response. The neutralising antibody responses elicited were only detected in serum of cows vaccinated via the intramuscular route. Conclusions: These preliminary findings support the feasibility of ChAd-vectored vaccination as a strategy to induce humoral immunity in cattle against emerging H5N1 influenza A viruses. Cross-reactive antibody responses against both A/dairy cattle/Texas/24-008749_001/2024 and A/Ibis/Egypt/RLQP-229S/2022 support the capacity of the vaccine to recognise antigenically related H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses circulating in mammalian and avian reservoirs. Further studies of vaccine efficacy and the immunological mechanism of protection should now be undertaken with the aim of reducing viral transmission and milk-associated shedding in dairy herds.

Six animals received either intramuscular or intranasal vaccination, and humoral responses were measured in serum and milk using ELISA, hemagglutination, and neutralisation assays. elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 泌乳奶牛使用黑猩猩腺病毒载体 疫苗 进行疫苗接种,该 疫苗 表达来自奶牛分离株 A/奶牛/德克萨斯州的血凝素 5 抗原 (H5HA),采用肌内注射 (N = 3) 或鼻内注射 (N = 3)。
elements_zh.methods: 通过 ELISA 评估牛奶和血清中的 H5HA 进化枝 2.3.4.4b 抗体,并评估血凝和中和能力。
elements_zh.main_results: 在肠胃外接种疫苗的动物的血清和牛奶中检测到 IgG 和 IgA H5HA 特异性抗体,而仅在通过肌内途径接种疫苗的奶牛的血清中检测到中和抗体反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为支持 ChAd 载体 疫苗接种 在牛中诱导针对新出现的 H5N1 甲型流感病毒的体液免疫的可行性,并注意到针对抗原相关的 H5N1 分支 2.3.4.4b 病毒的交叉反应性抗体反应。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些初步研究结果表明,疫苗接种 策略有可能减少奶牛群中的病毒 传播 和与牛奶相关的脱落,为未来的 监测 和牛中 H5N1 的控制措施提供信息。

In response to this emerging threat, we developed a chimpanzee adenovirus (ChAd)-vectored vaccine expressing the haemagglutinin 5 antigen (H5HA) from the dairy cattle isolate A/dairy cattle/Texas. Methods: Lactating dairy cows were vaccinated by either intramuscular (N = 3) or intranasal administration (N = 3). H5HA clade 2.3.4.4b antibodies in cow’s milk and sera were evaluated by ELISA. Hemagglutination and neutralisation capacity were also evaluated. Results: IgG and IgA H5HA-specific antibodies were detected in serum and milk from parenterally vaccinated animals, demonstrating the induction of a systemic immune response. The neutralising antibody responses elicited were only detected in serum of cows vaccinated via the intramuscular route. Conclusions: These preliminary findings support the feasibility of ChAd-vectored vaccination as a strategy to induce humoral immunity in cattle against emerging H5N1 influenza A viruses. Cross-reactive antibody responses against both A/dairy cattle/Texas/24-008749_001/2024 and A/Ibis/Egypt/RLQP-229S/2022 support the capacity of the vaccine to recognise antigenically related H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses circulating in mammalian and avian reservoirs. Further studies of vaccine efficacy and the immunological mechanism of protection should now be undertaken with the aim of reducing viral transmission and milk-associated shedding in dairy herds.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标:美国奶牛中 高致病性禽流感 A (H5N1) 病毒感染的出现揭示了一种新型哺乳动物 宿主 以及涉及原料奶和乳制品生产系统的潜在 传播 途径。H5N1 在奶牛群中的持续传播令人担忧,因为哺乳动物中持续的病毒适应可能会增加高效哺乳动物 传播 和随后的人畜共患传播的风险。为了应对这一新出现的威胁,我们开发了一种黑猩猩腺病毒 (ChAd) 载体 疫苗,表达来自奶牛分离株 A/德克萨斯州奶牛的血凝素 5 抗原 (H5HA)。方法:泌乳奶牛通过肌肉注射(N = 3)或鼻内注射(N = 3)进行疫苗接种。通过 ELISA 评估牛奶和血清中的 H5HA 进化枝 2.3.4.4b 抗体。还评估了血凝和中和能力。结果:在肠外接种疫苗的动物的血清和乳汁中检测到 IgG 和 IgA H5HA 特异性抗体,证明了系统性 免疫应答 的诱导。所引发的中和抗体反应仅在通过肌内途径接种疫苗的奶牛的血清中检测到。结论:这些初步研究结果支持 ChAd 载体 疫苗接种 作为诱导牛针对新出现的 H5N1 甲型流感病毒的体液免疫策略的可行性。针对 A/奶牛/德克萨斯/24-008749_001/2024 和 A/Ibis/埃及/RLQP-229S/2022 的交叉反应抗体反应支持 疫苗 识别在哺乳动物和鸟类 储存宿主 中传播的抗原相关 H5N1 分支 2.3.4.4b 病毒的能力。现在应该对 疫苗 功效和免疫保护机制进行进一步研究,以减少奶牛群中的病毒 传播 和与牛奶相关的脱落。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 美国奶牛中 高致病性禽流感 A (H5N1) 病毒感染的出现揭示了一种新型哺乳动物 宿主 以及涉及原料奶和乳制品生产系统的潜在 传播 途径,引发了人们对病毒持续适应以及哺乳动物 传播 和人畜共患传播风险增加的担忧。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 泌乳奶牛使用黑猩猩腺病毒载体 疫苗 进行疫苗接种,该 疫苗 表达来自奶牛分离株 A/奶牛/德克萨斯州的血凝素 5 抗原 (H5HA),采用肌内注射 (N = 3) 或鼻内注射 (N = 3)。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过 ELISA 评估牛奶和血清中的 H5HA 进化枝 2.3.4.4b 抗体,并评估血凝和中和能力。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在肠胃外接种疫苗的动物的血清和牛奶中检测到 IgG 和 IgA H5HA 特异性抗体,而仅在通过肌内途径接种疫苗的奶牛的血清中检测到中和抗体反应。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为支持 ChAd 载体 疫苗接种 在牛中诱导针对新出现的 H5N1 甲型流感病毒的体液免疫的可行性,并注意到针对抗原相关的 H5N1 分支 2.3.4.4b 病毒的交叉反应性抗体反应。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些初步研究结果表明,疫苗接种 策略有可能减少奶牛群中的病毒 传播 和与牛奶相关的脱落,为未来的 监测 和牛中 H5N1 的控制措施提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小(N = 6)、缺乏功效测试和缺乏机械免疫学数据的限制,需要进行低置信度评估。

papers.title: Immunogenicity and Protective Efficacy of a Serum-Free Suspension MDCK Cell Culture-Based Inactivated H3N8 Avian Influenza Vaccine Compared with an Egg-Based Counterpart in Chickens
papers.abstract: H3N8 subtype avian influenza virus (AIV) circulates in poultry with occasional zoonotic potential and vaccines are crucial for preventing and controlling avian influenza.Here, two inactivated vaccines were prepared against the H3N8 AIV with GD1102 as vaccine strain: an embryonated chicken egg-based vaccine (E-vac) and a serum-free suspension MDCK cell-based vaccine (C-vac).The efficacy of both vaccines was evaluated in specific pathogen-free chickens.All vaccinated groups and the challenge control were intranasally challenged with 10 6 EID50 of GD1102 at 14 days post-vaccination (dpv) while the negative control group received no challenge.HI antibody titers, viral shedding, tissue viral loads, and pathological lesions were systematically assessed.Both vaccines elicited robust humoral immune responses at 7 dpv and the C-vac group had significantly higher HI titers than the E-vac group (p 6 log2).Compared with the control group, both vaccines effectively reduced viral shedding and lessened histopathological lesions.These findings suggest that C-vac elicits a rapid antibody response and confers effective protection.Therefore, C-vac can be considered a promising new platform for H3N8 avian influenza vaccines.

analysis.research_question_and_background: H3N8 avian influenza virus circulates in poultry with occasional zoonotic potential, creating a need for effective vaccines. The study aimed to compare the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a serum-free suspension MDCK cell culture-based inactivated H3N8 vaccine with an egg-based counterpart in chickens.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated two inactivated H3N8 avian influenza vaccines in specific pathogen-free chickens: an embryonated chicken egg-based vaccine (E-vac) and a serum-free suspension MDCK cell-based vaccine (C-vac). Vaccinated groups and a challenge control were intranasally challenged with 10^6 EID50 of the GD1102 strain at 14 days post-vaccination, while a negative control group received no challenge.
analysis.methods: Both vaccines were prepared using the GD1102 H3N8 strain. Humoral immune responses were assessed via hemagglutination inhibition (HI) antibody titers at 7 days post-vaccination. Protection was evaluated by measuring viral shedding, tissue viral loads, and histopathological lesions after challenge.
analysis.main_results: Both vaccines elicited robust humoral immune responses at 7 days post-vaccination, with the C-vac group showing significantly higher HI titers than the E-vac group (p < 0.05). Compared with the control group, both vaccines effectively reduced viral shedding and lessened histopathological lesions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the C-vac platform elicits a rapid antibody response and confers effective protection against H3N8 avian influenza in chickens. They concluded that C-vac represents a promising new vaccine platform for H3N8 avian influenza.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that serum-free suspension MDCK cell-based inactivated vaccines may offer advantages over traditional egg-based vaccines for H3N8 avian influenza control in poultry. This platform could inform future vaccine development and deployment strategies for avian influenza prevention.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in specific pathogen-free chickens and did not assess zoonotic transmission risk or long-term immunity. The evidence strength is moderate due to the limited scope of the animal model and absence of human-relevant endpoints.

analysis.summary_en: This study compared a serum-free suspension MDCK cell culture-based inactivated H3N8 avian influenza vaccine (C-vac) with an egg-based counterpart (E-vac) in specific pathogen-free chickens. Both vaccines induced robust humoral responses by 7 days post-vaccination, with C-vac showing significantly higher hemagglutination inhibition titers. Upon challenge with the GD1102 strain, both vaccines reduced viral shedding and histopathological lesions compared to controls. The authors conclude that C-vac is a promising new platform for H3N8 avian influenza vaccines. While the findings support the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of C-vac in poultry, the study's evidence strength is moderate due to its animal-only model and lack of human-relevant endpoints.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: H3N8 禽流感 病毒在家禽中传播,偶尔具有人畜共患病的可能性,因此需要有效的 疫苗。该研究旨在比较基于无血清悬浮 MDCK 细胞培养的灭活 H3N8 疫苗 与基于鸡蛋的对应物在鸡中的免疫原性和保护功效。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了特定无病原体鸡中的两种灭活 H3N8 禽流感 疫苗:一种基于含胚鸡蛋的 疫苗 (E-vac) 和一种基于无血清悬浮 MDCK 细胞的 疫苗 (C-vac)。在 疫苗接种 后 14 天,接种组和攻击对照用 10^6 EID50 的 GD1102 菌株鼻内攻击,而阴性对照组不接受攻击。
elements_zh.methods: 两种 疫苗 均使用 GD1102 H3N8 菌株制备。在 疫苗接种 后 7 天通过血凝抑制 (HI) 抗体滴度评估体液 免疫应答。通过测量攻击后的病毒脱落、组织病毒载量和组织病理学病变来评估保护作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 两种 疫苗 在 疫苗接种 后 7 天均引发强劲的体液 免疫应答,其中 C-vac 组显示出显着高于 E-vac 组的 HI 滴度 (p < 0.05)。与对照组相比,疫苗 均有效减少病毒脱落并减轻组织病理学病变。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,C-vac 平台可引发快速抗体反应,并为鸡提供针对 H3N8 禽流感 的有效保护。他们得出的结论是,C-vac 代表了 H3N8 禽流感 的一个有前途的新 疫苗 平台。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,基于无血清悬浮 MDCK 细胞的灭活 疫苗 可能比传统的基于鸡蛋的 疫苗 在家禽中控制 H3N8 疫苗 具有优势。该平台可以为未来的 疫苗 开发和 禽流感 预防部署策略提供信息。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: H3N8 avian influenza virus circulates in poultry with occasional zoonotic potential, creating a need for effective vaccines. The study aimed to compare the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a serum-free suspension MDCK cell culture-based inactivated H3N8 vaccine with an egg-based counterpart in chickens.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated two inactivated H3N8 avian influenza vaccines in specific pathogen-free chickens: an embryonated chicken egg-based vaccine (E-vac) and a serum-free suspension MDCK cell-based vaccine (C-vac). Vaccinated groups and a challenge control were intranasally challenged with 10^6 EID50 of the GD1102 strain at 14 days post-vaccination, while a negative control group received no challenge.
analysis_en.methods: Both vaccines were prepared using the GD1102 H3N8 strain. Humoral immune responses were assessed via hemagglutination inhibition (HI) antibody titers at 7 days post-vaccination. Protection was evaluated by measuring viral shedding, tissue viral loads, and histopathological lesions after challenge.
analysis_en.main_results: Both vaccines elicited robust humoral immune responses at 7 days post-vaccination, with the C-vac group showing significantly higher HI titers than the E-vac group (p < 0.05). Compared with the control group, both vaccines effectively reduced viral shedding and lessened histopathological lesions.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the C-vac platform elicits a rapid antibody response and confers effective protection against H3N8 avian influenza in chickens. They concluded that C-vac represents a promising new vaccine platform for H3N8 avian influenza.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that serum-free suspension MDCK cell-based inactivated vaccines may offer advantages over traditional egg-based vaccines for H3N8 avian influenza control in poultry. This platform could inform future vaccine development and deployment strategies for avian influenza prevention.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in specific pathogen-free chickens and did not assess zoonotic transmission risk or long-term immunity. The evidence strength is moderate due to the limited scope of the animal model and absence of human-relevant endpoints.

papers.title: Understanding moral trade-offs in pandemic response: A discrete choice experiment on avian influenza policies
papers.abstract: Pandemic preparedness requires navigating trade-offs between health, economic, and social impacts; choices that often involve moral tensions. This study investigates how the Dutch public evaluates such trade-offs in the context of a potential outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI). Using a discrete choice experiment (DCE) administered to a representative sample of 1,045 respondents from the LISS panel, we examined preferences across six policy outcomes: mortality, lasting physical and mental injuries, postponed healthcare, social restrictions, and one-off tax payments. A latent class logit model identified four distinct preference profiles, revealing substantial heterogeneity in moral and economic reasoning. Two classes exhibited taboo trade-off aversion (TTOA) when values such as life or human dignity were traded against monetary costs. Respondents displaying TTOA emphasized solidarity and governmental responsibility, while cost-sensitive groups prioritized economic efficiency. These findings highlight that public acceptance of pandemic policies depends not only on effectiveness and cost but also on perceived moral legitimacy. Accounting for TTOA in economic evaluation can improve the ethical considerations and societal acceptability of future pandemic preparedness strategies.

Using a discrete choice experiment with 1,045 respondents, the research identifies varying preferences across six policy outcomes, including mortality, injuries, healthcare delays, social restrictions, and tax payments. The analysis reveals four distinct preference profiles, highlighting substantial differences in moral and economic reasoning. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 流行病防范需要在健康、经济和社会影响之间进行权衡;往往涉及道德紧张的选择。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究调查了荷兰公众如何在 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 的潜在 暴发 背景下评估此类权衡。
elements_zh.methods: 通过对 LISS 小组中 1,045 名受访者的代表性样本进行离散选择实验 (DCE),我们检查了六种政策结果的偏好:死亡率、持久的身体和精神伤害、推迟医疗保健、社会限制和一次性纳税。

papers.title_zh: 了解大流行应对中的道德权衡:禽流感 政策的离散选择实验
papers.source_body_en: Pandemic preparedness requires navigating trade-offs between health, economic, and social impacts; choices that often involve moral tensions. This study investigates how the Dutch public evaluates such trade-offs in the context of a potential outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI). Using a discrete choice experiment (DCE) administered to a representative sample of 1,045 respondents from the LISS panel, we examined preferences across six policy outcomes: mortality, lasting physical and mental injuries, postponed healthcare, social restrictions, and one-off tax payments. A latent class logit model identified four distinct preference profiles, revealing substantial heterogeneity in moral and economic reasoning. Two classes exhibited taboo trade-off aversion (TTOA) when values such as life or human dignity were traded against monetary costs. Respondents displaying TTOA emphasized solidarity and governmental responsibility, while cost-sensitive groups prioritized economic efficiency. These findings highlight that public acceptance of pandemic policies depends not only on effectiveness and cost but also on perceived moral legitimacy. Accounting for TTOA in economic evaluation can improve the ethical considerations and societal acceptability of future pandemic preparedness strategies.

papers.title: Generation of Nasal Cell-Derived Human Alveolar Organoids and Organoid-Macrophage Assembloids for in Vitro Lung Modeling.
papers.abstract: We established robust protocols to generate physiological and functional alveolar organoids (nsoAlvO) from readily accessible and expandable nasal cell-derived organoids, and alveolar macrophages (monoAM) from peripheral blood monocytes. Through co-culture of nsoAlvO and monoAM, we generated organoid-macrophage assembloids, in which both components exhibited enhanced maturation. Comprehensive analyses, including immunostaining, functional assays, and single-cell RNA sequencing, demonstrated that the nsoAlvO and monoAM phenotypically and functionally resemble their native counterparts and engage in dynamic and extensive epithelial-macrophage communications. SSEA-1+ club cells were identified as the primary alveolar progenitor cells for nsoAlvO. Influenza virus infection in nsoAlvO revealed differential replicative fitness of H5N1 and H1N1 viruses, which recapitulate their authentic tropism in vivo. Notably, the addition of monoAM reduced H5N1 and H1N1 infection in nsoAlvO, suggesting a protective effect of alveolar macrophages against virus dissemination. These human alveolar organoids and organoid-macrophage assembloids provide universally accessible and physiologically relevant in vitro lung models for biomedical research and translational medicine.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the need for physiologically relevant human lung models to study respiratory infections and host-pathogen interactions, highlighting limitations of existing in vitro systems for avian influenza research.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research generated nasal cell-derived human alveolar organoids and alveolar macrophages from peripheral blood monocytes, then co-cultured them to create organoid-macrophage assembloids for in vitro modeling.
analysis.methods: The authors used immunostaining, functional assays, and single-cell RNA sequencing to validate that the organoids and macrophages phenotypically and functionally resembled native lung tissues and demonstrated epithelial-macrophage communications.
analysis.main_results: SSEA-1+ club cells were identified as the primary alveolar progenitor cells for nasal cell-derived alveolar organoids, and influenza virus infection experiments showed differential replicative fitness between H5N1 and H1N1 viruses that matched their authentic in vivo tropism.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The addition of alveolar macrophages to the organoids reduced infection by both H5N1 and H1N1 viruses, suggesting a protective role of macrophages against viral dissemination, and the models provided universally accessible in vitro systems for translational research.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These human alveolar organoids and assembloids offer physiologically relevant platforms for studying avian influenza pathogenesis, host responses, and evaluating antiviral strategies or vaccine candidates.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to in vitro modeling and does not include clinical or epidemiological data, which constrains the generalizability of findings to human infections and reduces the strength of evidence to moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed nasal cell-derived human alveolar organoids and alveolar macrophages from peripheral blood monocytes, then co-cultured them into organoid-macrophage assembloids that exhibited enhanced maturation and dynamic epithelial-macrophage interactions. Using immunostaining, functional assays, and single-cell RNA sequencing, the authors validated that these components phenotypically and functionally resembled native lung tissues. SSEA-1+ club cells were identified as the primary alveolar progenitor cells for the organoids. Influenza virus infection experiments demonstrated differential replicative fitness between H5N1 and H1N1 viruses that recapitulated authentic in vivo tropism. Notably, the addition of alveolar macrophages reduced infection by both H5N1 and H1N1 viruses, suggesting a protective effect against viral dissemination. The authors propose these models as universally accessible and physiologically relevant in vitro platforms for biomedical research and translational medicine.

analysis_zh.methods: 作者使用免疫染色、功能测定和单细胞 RNA 测序来验证类器官和巨噬细胞在表型和功能上与天然肺组织相似,并证明了上皮-巨噬细胞之间的通讯。
analysis_zh.main_results: SSEA-1+ 俱乐部细胞被确定为鼻细胞衍生的肺泡类器官的主要肺泡祖细胞,流感病毒感染实验显示 H5N1 和 H1N1 病毒之间的复制适应性存在差异,与其真实的体内趋向性相匹配。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在类器官中添加肺泡巨噬细胞可减少 H5N1 和 H1N1 病毒的感染,表明巨噬细胞对病毒传播具有保护作用,并且该模型为转化研究提供了普遍可用的体外系统。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些人类肺泡类器官和组合体为研究 禽流感 发病机制、宿主 反应以及评估 抗病毒药物 策略或 疫苗 候选者提供了生理相关平台。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于体外模型,不包括临床或流行病学数据,这限制了研究结果对人类感染的普遍性,并将证据强度降低至中等。

papers.title: Detection of circovirus and herpesvirus co-infection in suddenly dead
papers.abstract: This article investigates the causes of the sudden death of six common ravens (Corvus corax). All six birds were found on the same day in central Poland. The ravens were necropsied, and samples were collected for bacteriological, histopathological, and toxicological examinations. The presence of genetic material from common viral and some bacterial pathogens was examined using molecular methods. The ravens were found to be in good nutritional condition. Two birds had enlarged spleens with petechiae on their surface. Histopathological examination revealed multifocal hemorrhages and inflammatory infiltrates composed of mononuclear cells in the liver, and intranuclear inclusion bodies in hepatocytes. In the kidneys, inflammation, hemorrhages, parenchymal degeneration, and necrosis of the renal tubular epithelium were detected. Mild lymphocytic-plasmacytic inflammation was found in the intestines. Molecular tests were performed for circoviruses, herpesviruses, flaviviruses, adenoviruses, polyomavirus, avian bornavirus, avian paramyxovirus-1, rotavirus, avian reovirus, avian influenza viruses, Chlamydia spp., Salmonella spp., Clostridium spp., botulin toxins (A-E). Only PCR tests for circoviruses and herpesviruses yielded positive results. Toxicological tests were performed for the presence of organophosphate pesticides, rodenticides, coccidiostats, mycotoxins, and fungicides. Low and trace concentrations of brodifacoum (an anticoagulant rodenticide) and pentobarbital (a barbiturate) were detected. The remaining results were negative. There is a strong suspicion that the primary cause of death in the studied birds was raven herpesvirus, described in this case for the first time, with possible involvement of circovirus. However, other factors, including poisoning or other unknown viruses, cannot be ruled out. Although the toxicology profile was broad, it did not include all possible toxins.

analysis.methods: Necropsies included bacteriological, histopathological, and toxicological analyses, while molecular methods screened for circoviruses, herpesviruses, flaviviruses, adenoviruses, polyomavirus, avian bornavirus, avian paramyxovirus-1, rotavirus, avian reovirus, avian influenza viruses, Chlamydia spp., Salmonella spp., Clostridium spp., and botulin toxins.

analysis.summary_en: This case report investigated the sudden death of six common ravens in central Poland through comprehensive necropsy, histopathological, toxicological, and molecular analyses. Histopathological findings included multifocal hemorrhages, inflammatory infiltrates in the liver, intranuclear inclusion bodies in hepatocytes, renal inflammation, degeneration, and necrosis, alongside mild intestinal inflammation. Molecular testing identified circovirus and herpesvirus co-infection, with toxicological analysis detecting low concentrations of brodifacoum and pentobarbital. The authors suspected raven herpesvirus as the primary cause of death, reported for the first time in this species, though other factors such as poisoning or unknown pathogens could not be ruled out. The study underscores the importance of targeted surveillance for herpesvirus and circovirus in corvids for wildlife health and potential zoonotic risk assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究通过调查潜在的病毒和毒性原因解决了六只普通乌鸦(Corvus corax)的突然死亡问题,因为尽管鸟类营养状况良好,但潜在的病因仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 同一天,在波兰中部发现六只死亡乌鸦,并对其进行了尸检,并收集样本进行细菌学、组织病理学、毒理学和分子检查,以鉴定病原体和毒素。
elements_zh.methods: 尸检包括细菌学、组织病理学和毒理学分析,同时分子方法筛选圆环病毒、疱疹病毒、黄病毒、腺病毒、多瘤病毒、禽博尔纳病毒、禽副粘病毒-1、轮状病毒、禽呼肠孤病毒、禽流感病毒、衣原体属、沙门氏菌属、梭菌属和肉毒杆菌毒素。
elements_zh.main_results: 组织病理学检查显示多灶性出血、肝脏炎症浸润、肝细胞核内包涵体、肾脏炎症、出血、实质变性、肾小管上皮坏死以及肠道轻度淋巴细胞浆细胞炎症。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者怀疑乌鸦疱疹病毒是乌鸦疱疹病毒的主要原因,这是首次在该物种中报道,可能与圆环病毒有关,但不能排除中毒或未知病毒等其他因素。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要针对鸦科动物的疱疹病毒和圆环病毒制定针对性的 监测 和诊断方案,以便为野生动物健康管理和潜在的人畜共患病风险评估提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小、缺乏对照鸟类、毒理学筛查不完整以及依赖分子检测而没有病毒分离的限制,因此评估的置信度较低。

papers.abstract_zh: 本文调查了六只普通乌鸦 (Corvus corax) 猝死的原因。所有六只鸟均于同一天在波兰中部被发现。对乌鸦进行尸检,并收集样本进行细菌学、组织病理学和毒理学检查。使用分子方法检查了常见病毒和一些细菌病原体的遗传物质的存在。发现乌鸦营养状况良好。两只鸟的脾脏肿大,表面有瘀点。组织病理学检查显示肝脏中多灶性出血和由单核细胞组成的炎症浸润,以及肝细胞中的核内包涵体。在肾脏中,检测到炎症、出血、实质变性和肾小管上皮坏死。肠道内发现轻度淋巴细胞浆细胞炎症。对圆环病毒、疱疹病毒、黄病毒、腺病毒、多瘤病毒、禽博纳病毒、禽副粘病毒-1、轮状病毒、禽呼肠孤病毒、禽流感病毒、衣原体属、沙门氏菌属、梭菌属、肉毒毒素(A-E)进行了分子检测。只有圆环病毒和疱疹病毒的 PCR 检测得出阳性结果。对有机磷杀虫剂、杀鼠剂、抗球虫剂、霉菌毒素和杀菌剂的存在进行了毒理学测试。检测到低浓度和痕量的溴鼠灵(一种抗凝血灭鼠剂)和戊巴比妥(一种巴比妥酸盐)。其余结果均为阴性。人们强烈怀疑所研究鸟类的主要原因是乌鸦疱疹病毒,这在本例中是首次描述,可能与圆环病毒有关。但不能排除其他因素,包括中毒或其他未知病毒。尽管毒理学概况很广泛,但它并不包括所有可能的毒素。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究通过调查潜在的病毒和毒性原因解决了六只普通乌鸦(Corvus corax)的突然死亡问题,因为尽管鸟类营养状况良好,但潜在的病因仍不清楚。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 同一天,在波兰中部发现六只死亡乌鸦,并对其进行了尸检,并收集样本进行细菌学、组织病理学、毒理学和分子检查,以鉴定病原体和毒素。
analysis_zh.methods: 尸检包括细菌学、组织病理学和毒理学分析,同时分子方法筛选圆环病毒、疱疹病毒、黄病毒、腺病毒、多瘤病毒、禽博尔纳病毒、禽副粘病毒-1、轮状病毒、禽呼肠孤病毒、禽流感病毒、衣原体属、沙门氏菌属、梭菌属和肉毒杆菌毒素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 组织病理学检查显示多灶性出血、肝脏炎症浸润、肝细胞核内包涵体、肾脏炎症、出血、实质变性、肾小管上皮坏死以及肠道轻度淋巴细胞浆细胞炎症。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者怀疑乌鸦疱疹病毒是乌鸦疱疹病毒的主要原因,这是首次在该物种中报道,可能与圆环病毒有关,但不能排除中毒或未知病毒等其他因素。

papers.title: The complexity of protecting poultry from HPAIV: Findings from a case-control study in Sweden.
papers.abstract: High pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) has caused severe disruptions to poultry production worldwide and in Sweden in the last decade. During 2020 and 2021, 18 outbreaks were confirmed in poultry due to viral introduction from wild birds. The aim of the study was to investigate farm-level risk factors for HPAI in Swedish poultry, to guide prevention measures. A case-control study based on 15 cases from 2020 and 2021 and 33 controls, representing four poultry categories and three counties in southern Sweden was conducted. Data were collected through interviews with farmers/ farmworkers and on-farm observations using a questionnaire and Biocheck.UGentTM. Predictor variables were selected based on a hypothesised causal diagram and included in a case-control model using stability selection based on three regularisation models. In addition, a cross-sectional analysis was done based on poultry registry data, and six years of outbreak data. The case-control results showed an association between HPAI outbreaks and presence of waterfowl near the poultry farms. A higher number of birds per farm was positively associated with outbreaks in both parts of the study. Poultry category was associated with HPAI status where turkeys had higher risk and broilers lower risk of outbreaks in the cross-sectional study. The results didn't show a significant association between biosecurity score or other biosecurity covariates, but trends were identified that may deserve further research.

analysis.research_question_and_background: High pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) has caused severe disruptions to poultry production in Sweden and globally over the last decade, creating a need to identify farm-level risk factors to guide prevention measures.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A case-control study was conducted in southern Sweden, including 15 HPAI outbreak farms from 2020–2021 and 33 control farms across four poultry categories and three counties.
analysis.methods: Data were collected via farmer/farmworker interviews and on-farm observations using a questionnaire and the Biocheck.UGentTM tool, with predictor variables selected from a hypothesised causal diagram and analysed using stability selection based on three regularisation models.
analysis.main_results: The case-control analysis identified an association between HPAI outbreaks and the presence of waterfowl near poultry farms, while the cross-sectional study found that turkey farms had higher outbreak risk and broiler farms had lower risk.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights waterfowl proximity as a key risk factor for HPAI outbreaks in Swedish poultry, with poultry category (turkeys vs. broilers) also influencing risk, suggesting targeted biosecurity measures may be needed.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform targeted surveillance and biosecurity interventions in Swedish poultry farms, particularly in regions with high waterfowl activity or turkey production.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study did not find significant associations with biosecurity scores or other covariates, and trends identified require further research, limiting the strength of evidence for actionable conclusions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated farm-level risk factors for highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) outbreaks in Swedish poultry during 2020–2021 using a case-control design comparing 15 outbreak farms to 33 controls across four poultry categories and three counties. Data were collected through farmer interviews and on-farm observations using a structured questionnaire and the Biocheck.UGentTM tool, with risk factors analysed via stability selection models. The main findings showed that proximity to waterfowl and poultry category (higher risk in turkeys, lower in broilers) were associated with HPAI outbreaks. While the study did not identify significant associations with biosecurity scores, it suggests that targeted surveillance and biosecurity measures in high-risk settings, particularly near waterfowl habitats or turkey farms, may help mitigate future outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 过去十年中,高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI) 对瑞典和全球的家禽生产造成了严重破坏,因此需要确定农场层面的风险因素来指导预防措施。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在瑞典南部进行了一项病例对照研究,包括 2020 年至 2021 年期间的 15 个 HPAI 暴发 农场和横跨四个家禽类别和三个县的 33 个对照农场。
elements_zh.methods: 使用问卷和 Biocheck.UGentTM 工具通过农民/农场工人访谈和农场观察收集数据,从假设的因果图中选择预测变量,并使用基于三个正则化模型的稳定性选择进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 病例对照分析确定了 HPAI 暴发 与家禽养殖场附近水禽的存在之间存在关联,而横断面研究发现火鸡养殖场的 暴发 风险较高,而肉鸡养殖场的风险较低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,水禽接近是瑞典家禽中 HPAI 暴发 的一个关键风险因素,家禽类别(火鸡与肉鸡)也会影响风险,这表明可能需要有针对性的生物安全措施。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为瑞典家禽养殖场的针对性 监测 和生物安全干预措施提供信息,特别是在水禽活动或火鸡生产较高的地区。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有发现与生物安全评分或其他协变量的显着关联,并且确定的趋势需要进一步研究,限制了可操作结论的证据强度。

Data were collected through interviews with farmers/ farmworkers and on-farm observations using a questionnaire and Biocheck.UGentTM. Predictor variables were selected based on a hypothesised causal diagram and included in a case-control model using stability selection based on three regularisation models. In addition, a cross-sectional analysis was done based on poultry registry data, and six years of outbreak data. The case-control results showed an association between HPAI outbreaks and presence of waterfowl near the poultry farms. A higher number of birds per farm was positively associated with outbreaks in both parts of the study. Poultry category was associated with HPAI status where turkeys had higher risk and broilers lower risk of outbreaks in the cross-sectional study. The results didn't show a significant association between biosecurity score or other biosecurity covariates, but trends were identified that may deserve further research.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在瑞典南部进行了一项病例对照研究,包括 2020 年至 2021 年期间的 15 个 HPAI 暴发 农场和横跨四个家禽类别和三个县的 33 个对照农场。

papers.title: Development of a Visual Rapid Assay for Novel Goose Astrovirus Detection Based on RT-MIRA -PfAgo
papers.abstract: Goose astrovirus genotype 2 (GAstV-2) is an important pathogen associated with gosling gout, and rapid detection is useful for early diagnosis and field surveillance. In this study, a visual assay for GAstV-2 detection was developed by combining one-step reverse transcription multienzyme isothermal rapid amplification (MIRA) with the nucleic acid cleavage activity of Pyrococcus furiosus Argonaute (PfAgo). MIRA primers and specific guide DNAs were designed based on a conserved region of the GAstV-2 ORF1b gene, and the PfAgo reaction conditions were optimized. The optimal reaction contained 1.0 μM gDNA, 0.6 μM PfAgo, and 1.0 mM MnCl2. Using recombinant pUC57-ORF1b plasmid DNA as the template, the lowest detectable plasmid concentration under the tested conditions was 1.0 × 100 copies/μL. In the specificity assay, only GAstV-2 produced a positive signal, with no cross-reaction observed with GAstV-1, Tembusu virus, H9-subtype avian influenza virus, goose circovirus, fowl adenovirus serotype 4, or goose parvovirus. The assay was further tested with 23 clinical samples suspected of GAstV-2 infection. In a preliminary evaluation of 23 clinical samples, the RT-MIRA-PfAgo results were concordant with those obtained by conventional RT-PCR and RT-qPCR. Overall, the RT-MIRA-PfAgo assay provided sensitive and specific GAstV detection within a short time, without requiring programmed thermal cycling or an expensive real-time PCR instrument for routine endpoint detection. This method may be useful for GAstV-2 detection in basic laboratories and field settings.

papers.abstract_zh: 鹅星状病毒基因型2(GAstV-2)是与小鹅痛风相关的重要病原体,快速检测对于早期诊断和野外监测是有用的。在本研究中,通过将单步逆转录多酶等温快速扩增 (MIRA) 与激烈火球菌 Argonaute (PfAgo) 的核酸裂解活性相结合,开发了一种用于 GAstV-2 检测的可视化测定法。根据GAstV-2 ORF1b基因的保守区域设计MIRA引物和特异性引导DNA,并优化PfAgo反应条件。最佳反应包含 1.0 μM gDNA、0.6 μM PfAgo 和 1.0 mM MnCl2。以重组pUC57-ORF1b质粒DNA为模板,测试条件下可检测的最低质粒浓度为1.0×100拷贝/μL。在特异性测定中,仅GAstV-2产生阳性信号,与GAstV-1、天布苏病毒、H9亚型禽流感病毒、鹅圆环病毒、禽腺病毒血清型4或鹅细小病毒没有观察到交叉反应。该测定法进一步测试了 23 个疑似 GAstV-2 感染的临床样本。在对23个临床样本的初步评估中,RT-MIRA-PfAgo结果与常规RT-PCR和RT-qPCR获得的结果一致。总体而言,RT-MIRA-PfAgo 检测可在短时间内提供灵敏且特异的 GAstV 检测,无需编程热循环或昂贵的实时 PCR 仪器进行常规终点检测。该方法可能对基础实验室和现场环境中的 GAstV-2 检测有用。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 鹅星状病毒基因型 2 (GAstV-2) 会导致小鹅痛风,这是一种需要快速检测早期 诊断 和现场 监测 的疾病,但传统方法非常耗时且需要专门设备。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一种利用一步逆转录多酶等温快速扩增 (MIRA) 结合激烈火球菌 Argonaute (PfAgo) 核酸裂解活性来检测 GAstV-2 的视觉检测方法。
analysis_zh.methods: MIRA 引物和引导 DNA 的设计针对 GAstV-2 ORF1b 基因的保守区域,并使用 1.0 μM gDNA、0.6 μM PfAgo 和 1.0 mM MnCl2 优化 PfAgo 反应条件。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该检测仅检测到 1.0 × 100 拷贝/μL 的重组质粒 DNA 模板,并且与 GAstV-1、天布苏病毒、H9 亚型 禽流感 病毒、鹅圆环病毒、禽腺病毒血清型 4 或鹅细小病毒没有交叉反应。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: RT-MIRA-PfAgo 检测提供了灵敏且特异的 GAstV-2 检测,无需热循环或昂贵的实时 PCR 仪器,代表了一种适合基础实验室和现场设置的新型视觉检测方法。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该方法可以在资源有限的环境中对早期 诊断 和 监测 进行快速、低成本的 GAstV-2 检测,从而有可能改善 暴发 的控制并减少水禽养殖的经济损失。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于 23 个临床样本和质粒 DNA 的初步评估,缺乏大规模验证、临床性能指标和现场稳健性评估,因此需要中等可信度。

news.content: Skip to navigation Skip to content A NSW Government website NSW Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development Open Menu Show Search Search site for: Close search Menu Close Menu Fishing Back to previous menu Close Menu Fishing Recreational Fishing Fish Passage NSW NSW Estuary Asset Protection Program Aboriginal fishing Aquaculture Hunting Back to previous menu Close Menu Hunting Agriculture Back to previous menu Close Menu Agriculture The GATE Animals & livestock Back to previous menu Close Menu Animals & livestock Animal welfare Dairy Animal Ethics Infolink Pigs Poultry Forestry Back to previous menu Close Menu Forestry Biosecurity Back to previous menu Close Menu Biosecurity Managing biosecurity in NSW Your role in biosecurity Report a pest or disease Animal biosecurity Aquatic biosecurity Plant biosecurity Invasive plants and animals Services and support Emergency management Independent Biosecurity Commissioner Climate Back to previous menu Close Menu Climate Understanding of the impacts of climate change and climate extremes on primary industries Current seasonal conditions Seasonal conditions and drought Climate Vulnerability Assessment Low Emissions Agriculture Energy Farms of the Future overview Digital Agriculture News and Case Studies About Climate Branch Events Education & training Back to previous menu Close Menu Education & training H5N1 Avian influenza (H5 bird flu) Home Biosecurity Animal biosecurity Avian influenza Last updated 10 August 2026 Current situation H5 bird flu has been detected in 4 birds from 3 locations in NSW, including: A single greater crested tern: South Coast (Narooma) A single greater crested tern: Western NSW (Wentworth) Two giant petrels: Mid North Coast (Hawks Nest) Bird flu has not been detected in commercial poultry flocks, captive birds or any other birds anywhere in Australia. There is no evidence of any mass mortality in wildlife or spread to other animals in NSW, and the risk to human health remains low. For confirmed cases in other states, visit Bird flu (Avian influenza) - DAFF Overseas, this strain has caused severe disease and high death rates in poultry, wild birds and other wildlife. Human cases are rare, and the virus does not spread easily between people. The NSW Government is working in collaboration with other jurisdictions and the Australian Government, with surveillance continuing to ensure early detection of any further cases. Public reporting is a critical part of the response and supporting ongoing detection efforts. If you see sick or dead birds or other animals, do not touch them. Avoid contact. Record what you see. Report multiple sick or dead birds or other animals to the Emergency Animal Disease Hotline on 1800 675 888 from anywhere in Australia. Australia has well-established national response arrangements in place to respond to animal disease incidents, including H5 bird flu. The NSW Government is reminding poultry producers that on-farm biosecurity practices are crucial to protect the health of their flocks. For more information, visit Bird flu (Avian influenza) - DAFF. What is avian influenza? Avian influenza is a viral disease of birds that is found globally. Virus strains are described as low pathogenicity (LPAI) or high pathogenicity (HPAI). High pathogenicity H5N1 avian influenza (H5 bird flu) is currently impacting all parts of the world and has recently been confirmed for the first time in Australia. H5 bird flu differs from other avian influenza strains and has caused mass mortalities in poultry and many wild birds overseas, as well as some mammals, particularly marine mammals. While NSW has responded to HPAI H7 detections in the past, until recently, there has never been a detection of H5 bird flu in NSW. The NSW Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development (NSW DPIRD), in partnership with the Australian Government, leads the response to any detection of H5 bird flu in NSW. NSW DPIRD has strengthened surveillance and biosecurity preparedness through additional resources focused on early detection, while also delivering targeted awareness activities to support community reporting and industry preparedness. Despite this, it is important that we all continue to remain vigilant and report any sick or dead poultry, wild birds or wildlife. H5 bird flu: spreads more easily than other bird flu strains can kill large numbers of poultry, wild birds and some mammals has no effective treatment usually leads to poor outcomes for infected birds and mammals NSW has been preparing for a possible outbreak of H5 bird flu in Australia and is continuing work to enhance response capabilities. This includes considering the potential impacts to animals, people and our ecosystems. Report sick or dead birds or wildlife If you find sick or dead wild birds, domestic birds, marine mammals or other wildlife showing signs of H5 bird flu: Avoid contact with the animals and their environment. Record what you see: take photos or video if possible, and note the location Report it using this online form or call the Emergency Animal Disease Hotline on 1800 675 888. Injured birds should NOT be reported to the Emergency Animal Disease Hotline. To report injured wild birds needing veterinary care, contact your local wildlife carer organisations, e.g. WIRES on 1300 094 737. What you should report to us: Sick or dead birds of any species, including seabirds, wild birds, backyard poultry or pet birds, anywhere in NSW Sick or dead marine mammal species. What to expect following a report: When you make a report, an officer from the NSW Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development (DPIRD) will review and assess your report using information such as the species, number of birds affected, location and disease risk. Not all reports will lead to an investigation, collection or testing. Where further action is needed, we may contact you for more information or arrange collection and testing. DPIRD will confirm positive detections only. Please avoid direct contact with sick or dead wild birds. If you need to dispose of wild birds because you cannot prevent access to the carcasses by children or pets, please refer to the following guidance from NSW Health and DPIRD: Be careful around wildlife: protect yourself Disposal of bird carcasses from public and private land: General Public About H5 bird flu and the risk to NSW Symptoms of the disease and the current situation Advice for Government agencies Advice for government agencies on the management of H5 bird flu Poultry and captive bird keepers Minimise the risk to your poultry and kept birds H5 bird flu and livestock Find out about the risk to livestock and how to prepare your property Information for veterinarians Management of suspected cases of H5 bird flu Protecting our native species from H5 bird flu How we can protect our native species Advice for First Nations communities Find out the risks and how to stay safe H5 bird flu resources Factsheets, flyers and other resources

analysis.time: Published 10 August 2026; event detected in NSW during 2026 prior to publication.
analysis.location_and_population: New South Wales, Australia: South Coast (Narooma), Western NSW (Wentworth), Mid North Coast (Hawks Nest). Affected species: greater crested terns and giant petrels; no detection in commercial poultry, captive birds, or other Australian regions.
analysis.event: Confirmed detection of H5 bird flu (H5N1) in four wild birds across three NSW locations, reported by the NSW Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development (NSW DPIRD) in partnership with the Australian Government. The event is confirmed and under investigation.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: 4 confirmed cases in wild birds (1 greater crested tern in South Coast, 1 greater crested tern in Western NSW, 2 giant petrels in Mid North Coast). No mass mortality in wildlife, no spread to other animals, and no detection in commercial poultry or captive birds. Human health risk remains low; human cases are rare and the virus does not spread easily between people.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: NSW DPIRD leads the response with strengthened surveillance and biosecurity preparedness, including targeted awareness activities and additional resources for early detection. Surveillance is ongoing across jurisdictions. Public reporting is encouraged via the Emergency Animal Disease Hotline (1800 675 888) or online form. Not all reports lead to investigation or testing; DPIRD confirms positive detections only. Poultry producers are reminded to maintain on-farm biosecurity. Unresolved: potential future spread to poultry or mammals and ecosystem impacts remain under assessment.

analysis.brief_en: The NSW Department of Primary Industries confirmed H5 bird flu (H5N1) in four wild birds across three locations in New South Wales on 10 August 2026. Affected species include greater crested terns and giant petrels, with no detections in commercial poultry or captive birds. Authorities report no evidence of mass mortality or spread to other animals and assess the human health risk as low. Surveillance and biosecurity measures have been strengthened, with public reporting encouraged via a national hotline. NSW DPIRD is leading the response in collaboration with federal and state partners, while ongoing monitoring aims to detect any further cases early.

news.content_zh: 2026 年 8 月 10 日,新南威尔士州第一产业部确认新南威尔士州三个地点的四个 野生鸟类 感染了 H5 禽流感 (H5N1)。受影响的物种包括大凤头燕鸥和巨型海燕,但在商业家禽或圈养鸟类中未检测到。当局报告没有证据表明存在大规模 死亡率 或传播给其他动物,并评估人类健康风险较低。监测 和生物安全措施得到加强,鼓励通过国家热线进行公开报告。新南威尔士州 DPIRD 正在与联邦和州合作伙伴合作领导应对工作,同时持续监测旨在尽早发现任何进一步的病例。

analysis_zh.time: 2026 年 8 月 10 日发布;发布前 2026 年在新南威尔士州检测到的事件。
analysis_zh.location_and_population: 澳大利亚新南威尔士州:南海岸(纳鲁马)、新南威尔士州西部(温特沃斯)、中北海岸(鹰巢)。受影响的物种:大凤头燕鸥和巨型海燕;在商业家禽、圈养鸟类或澳大利亚其他地区未检测到。
analysis_zh.event: 新南威尔士州第一产业和区域发展部 (NSW DPIRD) 与澳大利亚政府合作报告称,新南威尔士州三个地点的四个 野生鸟类 已确认检测到 H5 禽流感 (H5N1)。该事件已得到证实并正在调查中。
analysis_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: 野生鸟类 确诊 4 例(南海岸 1 只大凤头燕鸥、新南威尔士州西部 1 只大凤头燕鸥、中北海岸 2 只巨型海燕)。在野生动物中没有发现大量 死亡率,没有传播到其他动物,也没有在商业家禽或圈养鸟类中检测到。人类健康风险仍然较低;人间病例很少见,而且该病毒不易在人与人之间传播。
analysis_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: 新南威尔士州 DPIRD 通过加强 监测 和生物安全准备来领导应对工作,包括有针对性的宣传活动和用于早期检测的额外资源。监测 正在跨司法管辖区进行。鼓励通过紧急动物疾病热线(1800 675 888)或在线表格进行公开报告。并非所有报告都会导致调查或测试;DPIRD 仅确认阳性检测。提醒家禽生产者维护农场生物安全。未解决:未来可能传播到家禽或哺乳动物,对生态系统的影响仍在评估中。
